description: Identify a Kingdom Hearts item from a marketplace listing (Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Suruga-ya, Mandarake, eBay…). Paste the listing title as-is (Japanese or English), e.g. {title: "一番くじ キングダムハーツ A賞 ソラ フィギュア 箱なし", price_jpy: 4500}. Returns candidates[] (sku_id, name_en, confidence 0-1, why, source_url; several when the title is ambiguous), weak_matches[] when unsure, conditions[] (Japanese condition words such as 未使用/箱なし explained), flags[] (bootleg caution notes, not a verdict), price (original price and listing-to-original ratio when price_jpy is given), acquisition notes and next_checks_en (what to ask the seller). Listing text is not stored. For many listings at once use resolve_listings_batch.

description.description: Part of the listing description, e.g. condition notes such as 開封済み. Optional; improves condition and bootleg checks.

price_jpy.description: Listing price in Japanese yen. Optional; enables the comparison with the original price.

src.description: Traffic-source tag for usage statistics, used by the website (optional; only the tag and time are logged). Agents can omit it.

url.description: Listing URL. Optional; not stored and not fetched.

name: resolve_listing
title: Resolve listing
